name: Lee Sin
title: the Blind Monk

Q.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
Q.description: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.9×bonus AD physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next 3 seconds. Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.9×bonus AD to (60/90/120/150/180 + 0.9×bonus AD) × 2 physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health.
Q.summary: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds. Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

W.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
W.description: Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself 60/105/150/195/240 + 0.8×AP Shield for 2 seconds. Lee Sin may Recast for the next 3 seconds. Recast: Lee Sin gains 10/14/18/22/26% Omnivamp for 4 seconds.
W.summary: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will. Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

E.name: Tempest / Cripple
E.description: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals 35/60/85/110/135 + 0.9×AD magic damage and reveals them for 4 seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next 3 seconds. Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by 35/45/55/65/75% decaying over 4 seconds.
E.summary: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple. Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

R.name: Dragon's Rage
R.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing 150/350/550 + 2×bonus AD physical damage. Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take 150/350/550 + 2×bonus AD plus 12/15/18% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage.
R.summary: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

Passive.name: Flurry
Passive.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.
Passive.summary: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Lee Sin is a high-skill fighter jungler who chases with Sonic Wave, protects allies with Safeguard and kicks enemies into his team with Dragon's Rage. He plays jungle and is strongest early, using his mobility to gank and make plays.
strengths: Very strong early ganks: Q gives a dash to the hit target and a reveal.
Safeguard dashes to an ally or ward and shields, giving him great mobility and escape.
Dragon's Rage kicks a target back, knocking up enemies it collides with; the Insec kick can win teamfights.
Flurry passive gives attack speed and energy after each ability.
Tempest/Cripple slows and reveals, helping his ganks.
weaknesses: Falls off late: his damage drops as enemies build health.
Q is a skillshot: missing it leaves him without his main engage.
Energy-based: running out of energy stops his combos.
High skill: mistakes with W or R can cost fights.
Weak when behind, since he relies on early pressure.

curve.lvl1: strong – Q plus Flurry autos win most level-1 jungle skirmishes
curve.lvl2: strong – Q into W ward hop lets him chase or escape
curve.lvl3: strong – E slow makes ganks stick
curve.lvl6: very strong – Dragon's Rage kicks a target into his team or away from theirs
curve.items: medium – first item: Eclipse, Sundered Sky or Black Cleaver; Sterak's Gage for survival
curve.late: okay – his damage falls off, but the kick stays a teamfight tool

profile.curveNote: Lee Sin is strong from early, especially once he has Q and W, and wants to snowball before the late game.
profile.waveClear: Good: Q and E clear camps.
profile.mobility: Very high: Q dash and W ward hop.

keyAbilities.engage: R (Dragon's Rage) kick into his team
keyAbilities.escape: W (Safeguard) to a ward or ally to escape
keyAbilities.answers: None. Lee Sin has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Flurry: after using an ability, his next two attacks gain attack speed and energy.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, stand behind minions, or block with a projectile block.
Q.notes: Sonic Wave: hits the first enemy and reveals them; recast dashes to them.

W.notes: Safeguard: dash to an ally or ward, shielding both; recast gives omnivamp.

E.answer: Walk out of range before the recast.
E.notes: Tempest: reveals enemies hit; recast slows them.

R.notes: Dragon's Rage: knocks back the target; enemies it collides with are knocked up.

profile.windowAgainst: Lee Sin's window is late, or when Q is on cooldown: he has no engage, and his damage falls off.
checks: Does Lee Sin land Q before going in?
Does Lee Sin kick a key target into his team?
